coordinator.scope: current-source isolated emulators; one attempt; no live patching

complete.json.coverage: Fresh candidate-source Android build with a test-only local emulator routing overlay; two isolated Android users; local Firebase Auth/Firestore and candidate HTTP handlers; keyboard occlusion and startup recovery; no production, real SMS, store attestation or physical-device certification

extended-complete.json.scope: Native UI plus independently read Auth/Firestore emulator state
extended-complete.json.expiry: Owned demo server record fault injection, not an accelerated five-minute UI timer

accessibility-complete.json.scope: One observed emulator layout and actual pairing; not physical-device, TalkBack or exhaustive accessibility certification

nativeRuns.scope: Actual native UI, two Android users, four fictional identities, original candidate HTTP handlers and local Auth/Firestore. No production SMS, Store attestation, physical-device or production capacity proof.
